tool.name: b2bTools: Biophysical predictors for single sequences
tool.help:
# B2BTools: Single Sequence Analysis
## Description The current Galaxy Tool is the implementation of the Bio2Byte tools for single protein sequence analysis. It receives amino-acid sequences in FASTA format and returns biophysical predictions depending on the predictors selected.
## Input Sequences The tool works with either single or multiple input files, just keeping in mind that the file must be a valid FASTA containing at least one sequence of amino acids. There is no limitation on the number of sequences per file, however, all the sequences must have at least 5 residues.
## Available Biophysical Predictors - **DynaMine**: Fast predictor of protein backbone dynamics using only sequence information as input. - **DisoMine**: Predicts protein disorder with recurrent neural networks. - **EFoldMine**: Predicts early folding events. - **Agmata**: Beta-sheet aggregation.
## Expected Results From a single FASTA file with N sequences, the process will produce: - Single JSON output - N tabular results - N predicted features plots (if `plot` parameter is checked) - Predicted feature plots (if `plot_all` parameter is checked)
## Example Checking `Plot` parameter implies that predicted features will be plotted in different files by input sequence. 11 input sequences x 9 predicted features = 99 plots in PNG format. Checking `Plot all` parameter implies that all the input sequences will be plotted together in order to compare predicted features. 9 predicted features = 9 plots in PNG format.
